DeployBot: Preflight checks for rollout r-2026-03-21-3 passed. Starting deploy window for service inference-embed-v2. SLO watch enabled: p95 latency, 5xx rate, kv-cache miss. Watch thresholds: p95 degrade >20% over baseline, 5xx >0.5% sustained. Dashboard: https://redwood.internal/dashboards/deploy/12345 :rotating_light:
Alex: Oncall here — I'll watch p95 and 5xx. Can someone confirm release-note link and the version pin?
Priya: Release notes PR: https://github.com/redwood/release-notes/pull/789 — pinned to model tag v2.1.4-quant. Rollout plan: 10% -> 50% -> 100% (approx 30m total).
Jamie: FYI embed route had a small 4% 5xx blip during preflight. Start canary at 5% to be safe. Alert if >0.5% for 5m.
Sam: Noted. I saw a kv-cache tail spike at ~14:02 (kvcache/shard-3 timeout). Quick triage command: `journalctl -u kvcache | tail -n 200 | grep timeout` — saving traces to failed-traces/ for sample.
Alex: If p95 > 500ms or 5xx > 0.5% (sustained) we pause and roll back to v2.1.3. Agree?
OpsLead: :thumbsup: Agreed. Rollback playbook ready: `deployctl rollback --id r-2026-03-21-2 --to-tag v2.1.3` and notify #incidents. Also enable trace sampling: `trace-sample --service=inference-embed --out=failed-traces/`
Priya: I'll add a note in the release notes about the kv-cache mismatch and the quantization tweak. Starting synthetic checks now: `curl -sS https://canary.redwood/synth/embed | jq .latency`
DeployBot: Traffic shift scheduled: 10% -> 20% at +10m. Monitoring hooks active: canary-slo-alert, deploy-watchdog. If an alert fires the bot will auto-pause and ping this thread.
Jamie: p95 currently ~380ms (baseline ~300ms). 5xx ~0.1%. kv miss rate holding steady.
Sam: :eyes: I'll keep tailing logs. Trigger condition: hold if 5xx >0.5% for 3 consecutive 1m buckets or kv timeout rate >0.2%.
Alex: OpsLead, can you encode those hold conditions in the bot?
OpsLead: Done. hold-conditions set to `p95_rel_increase>=20% OR 5xx_rate>=0.5% sustained 5m OR kv_timeout_rate>=0.2%`. Added runbook link in the deploy meta.
Priya: Release notes updated + changelog entry. CC'ing support for FYI.
DeployBot: Traffic shifted to 50% at +20m. No alerts fired. Rolling to 100% in 10m if metrics remain stable.
Jamie: No regressions observed so far, marking as :white_check_mark:.
Sam: Agree, continuing log watch. Will post here if anything spikes.
Alex: Thanks everyone — keeping this thread as the single-source for rollback decisions and release-note sync.
OpsLead: I'll close the deploy watch after the final 100% confirmation and post follow-up notes.
